title: OIR prediction
description: A pre-registered, time-bounded, falsifiable expectation. The counter_indicator field is what makes a prediction discriminating rather than merely directional.

observable.description: What a researcher could actually look at. 'Increased tension' is not observable; 'the ministry's published implementation schedule' is.

indicator.description: The specific signal and its source type.

confirm_if.description: Threshold for support. Must be checkable by a reader.

counter_indicator.description: What we would expect NOT to see if this hypothesis holds. A prediction without one cannot separate hypotheses.

separates.description: Hypothesis pairs this prediction can discriminate. Empty means directional only; mark strength weak.

registered_at.description: Must be earlier than the first INV that tests it. Later registration marks the prediction late.

late.description: True when registered after the testing investigation began. Excluded from the hit rate.
